conviction_note: No pre-release and no profit warning, so Q3 is new information on a name whose six confirmed report days moved a median 8.6% (-13.0 to +9.8). The evidence nets to roughly nothing: Volvo CE's 23 Oct report raised its European market forecast (a positive read-across), while the bar is demanding, with consensus EBIT +23-27% y/y and SHB 6-9% above that. My own seasonal arithmetic puts EBIT a few percent under consensus. So p_up is 50, abs_move 7.5 and the scaled number 0. The findings sum to +0.10, close to 0, and the two measurements agree.

findings.finding: Volvo Group's Q3 report (23 Oct) raised Volvo CE's 2026 European construction-equipment market forecast to +5% to +15% from 0% to +10%. It says the European market grew 'in almost all countries', with Volvo-brand European orders +5% and deliveries +3% in units. This is a positive read-across for engcon's orders: Europe is 36% and the Nordics 51% of its order intake, and Volvo CE is an OEM partner. Germany is still weak.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Orders are the line engcon trades on. Q3 2025: orders +31% organic and the stock rose 1.2% on the day while EBIT fell 23%. Q2 2025: weak orders and margin, stock -13.0%.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced. engcon fell 1.2% on 23 Oct and rose 2.8% on 26 Oct, so the read-across was probably seen. It is excavator units in a market where engcon is gaining penetration. If it were fully priced, the stock would sit above its pre-Q2 level relative to the sector; it is up only 3.6% in a month. Sized small because it is a proxy (macro-to-company).
findings.independence: Volvo CE's own Q3 press summary repeats the European market growth (https://www.worldpipelines.com/business-news/23102026/volvo-construction-equipment-delivers-improved-earnings/). It is the same company, so not independent. SHB's 9 Oct note cites a European recovery (https://www.placera.se/telegram/engcon-shb-upprepar-kop-for-engcon-ser-attraktiv-vardering-20261009).

findings.finding: Seasonal arithmetic from engcon's own quarterly table puts Q3 EBIT at about 81-85 MSEK, a few percent below the 86-89 consensus. Q3 2025 opex was about 0.88 of Q2 opex, and the Q3/Q2 sales ratio was 0.78, giving sales of about 463. To reach consensus, gross margin must recover to 40% or more from 38.4% in Q2. A plausible route exists: NOKSEK averaged +7.8% y/y in Q3 against +5.8% in Q2, and USDSEK +1.5% against -3.1%, so currency turns from headwind toward tailwind. Net: slightly negative.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Margin misses have been punished: Q4 2025 (EBIT 72, 14.5% margin) -9.8%; Q2 2025 -13.0%. The margin recovery in Q1 and Q2 2026 brought +9.8% and +7.4%.
findings.why_not_priced: Consensus at 18.3% EBIT margin and SHB at about 19.5% both imply margin expansion in the seasonally weakest-volume quarter. If the market priced the deleverage, the sell-side would not be raising estimates (SHB +1-4% on 9 Oct). This is an inference, not a company number, so it stays small. The currency tailwind (Yahoo NOKSEK/USDSEK averages) offsets part of it and is netted inside this finding, not filed separately.
findings.independence: None from a different source. The FX averages come from Yahoo (https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/NOKSEK%3DX?range=2y&interval=1d).

findings.finding: Handelsbanken (9 Oct, Finwire) models Q3 sales +19.7% and EBIT +38%, 6% and 9% above consensus, and raised 2026-28 EBITA forecasts by 1-4%. The effective bar for the stock is therefore above the published consensus going into the print.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No record of how the stock reacted to a broker sitting above consensus.
findings.original_quote: SHB upprepar köp för Engcon - ser attraktiv värdering (Finwire). Per the fetched page, the bank expects Q3 sales up 19.7% and operating profit up 38%, 6 and 9 percent above consensus ('6 respektive 9 procent över konsensus').
findings.why_not_priced: Public for three weeks, so this is a bar effect rather than hidden information: a print at consensus reads as a miss against the whisper. The stock is +5.4% over 20 days and +3.6% over a month, consistent with some expectation build. MarketScreener also lists SB1 Markets reiterating buy on 7 Oct ('significant operating leverage').
findings.independence: MarketScreener lists the SB1 Markets buy, 7 Oct, citing operating leverage (https://uk.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/ENGCON-AB-144036889/calendar/). It points the same way, a high bar.
